name: Larios Dry Gin
history: 1863 | Larios family in Malaga moves into distillation
1916 | Family acquires Jimenez & Lamothe (wine and brandy)
1932 | Larios gin launched by José Aurelio Larios y Larios, third Marquis of Larios
2005 | Sold to Fortune Brands (July); now Suntory Global Spirits
notes: Botanicals not stated. Tasting notes from Difford's reviewer (2012). Fetched page names Destilerías DYC as producer, not a Malaga distillery as in backlog [cần kiểm tra]. Sibling names taken from search result titles.
